cards.headline: Staged with no cables: every musician was wireless
cards.snippet: In 2019, when David Byrne brought his American Utopia show to Broadway, he and eleven other musicians performed using only wireless or portable equipment. With no cables tying them down, the stage stayed open for choreography, which Annie-B Parson handled. Spike Lee later filmed the Broadway show as a concert film.
cards.context: The American Utopia show was later filmed by Spike Lee.

cards.headline: The concert film got a Criterion edition
cards.snippet: In December 2025, The Criterion Collection released American Utopia, the David Byrne concert film that includes this song in its setlist. It came out on 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray and DVD on December 16. The film had first aired on HBO in 2020, followed by a limited US theatrical run in September 2021.
cards.context: It followed an HBO premiere in 2020 and a limited theatrical run in 2021.

cards.headline: Solo in Rotterdam, under giant buildings
cards.snippet: Walking around Rotterdam, travelling solo. Looking up at all the giant architecture. Missing my friends and wanting to be home, this song really encapsulates how lonely it can be at times.
